title: Localized model portfolios & latency-fallback simulation for APAC SMBs
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: produce a prioritized set of localized model portfolios and automated fallback scenarios that maximize latency-sensitive feature availability for APAC small/medium customers while minimizing incremental cost.

Scope: (1) map likely local model entrants and regional hosting constraints across APAC clusters; (2) simulate multi-tier fallback ladders that combine hosted, dedicated, and on-prem variants by latency and cost; (3) produce procurement-ready portfolio recommendations and a small set of configuration templates for Redwood Console (routing policies + canary thresholds).

Why now: APAC latency complaints + initial partner signals show SMBs will tolerate moderate cost if latency <120ms for core flows. We need empiric simulations and fieldable configs before the next regional launch window.

Deliverables: prioritized portfolio matrix (per country), fallback policy templates, simulation notebook with scenario inputs, executive brief for Sales/Partnerships, and a short-run A/B test plan to validate in production beta.
updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff with APAC solutions leads; collected signal sources (Cloud region SLA, partner capacity, early customer latency logs).
2026-03-02: Initial model inventory drafted — includes 6 regional model variants and three quantized fallback options; estimated effective token cost delta by bucket. Link to raw sheet in links.

2026-03-09: Simulation prototype completed (latency + cost per 10k requests); baseline shows hosted-only approach fails latency SLO for JP and AU under medium load. Discussed hybrid dedicated+prefix-caching approach.

2026-03-12: Engineering feasibility sync — ENG owners suggest we can add region-pref routing + soft-fallback within 2 sprints if templates are small. Identified risk: KV cache consistency across fallbacks.
2026-03-16: Proposal drafted for three portfolio tiers (Economy, Balanced, Premium) with recommended routing policies and estimated monthly delta. Preparing exec briefing and procurement ask.
acceptance_criteria: A prioritized portfolio matrix covering top 6 APAC countries with rationale
Simulation notebook that reproduces latency/cost tradeoffs for each portfolio tier
Three fallback policy templates importable to Redwood Console routing config
Field test plan with measurable KPIs (p95 latency, error rate, cost per 1k requests) and rollout steps
Stakeholder sign-off from Sales APAC, Solutions, and ENG runtime lead
notes: Trade-offs discussed: prioritize latency for chat completion flows used in SMB CRMs; allow higher cost for Premium tier but require automatic cost guardrails. Next steps: finalize simulation parameters (traffic shape, cold-start mix), schedule field beta with two pilot customers in SG and JP.
